headline: Government clears FRA farmer payments in Gwembe’s Kkota Kkota Ward
summary: More than 200 farmers in Kkota Kkota Ward of Gwembe district who supplied maize to the Food Reserve Agency had received full payment as of November 20, a councillor said.
why: The Food Reserve Agency is Zambia's state grain buyer and stockholder, and its payments to maize farmers affect rural incomes and national food supply.
